name: Harpoon Troglodyte
flavour: It cannot see you. It does not need to.
art_prompt: a squat hunched troglodyte, an eyeless blind lizard-skinned humanoid with mottled dark red hide, a row of short spines along its head and back, a wide toad-like mouth with small teeth, a ragged hide loincloth and bone bracelets, holding a long barbed iron harpoon upright with a coil of rope over its shoulder, standing, menacing
motion: a heavy shuffling walk in place, the harpoon held ready, the eyeless head swaying as it listens
back_hint: seen from behind: the spiny back, the coil of rope over one shoulder and the harpoon's shaft rising past it, no face
dead_hint: lying dead on its back on the sand, the harpoon dropped beside it, the rope in a loose coil, the wide mouth open, the two arms and the two thick clawed legs sprawled out flat, feet with claws like the reference (no fins, no flippers, no tail)
doc: Blind, hardy and alone: never more than one on the map. It keeps twelve metres off and throws a bright red harpoon on a rope along a red line aimed at where you are going, not where you are. A hit ropes you to it for five seconds: it stays where it stood with its outline pulsing red and reels in any slack. Walking towards it costs nothing; walking away is 30% slower and drags it along behind you, digging in and kicking up sand. Kill it, or wait the rope out. A special from stage 2: specials come one at a time, the next 45 to 60 seconds after the last one dies.
